tickets.summary: MI - Widespread PIV login failures
tickets.details: Major incident declared. Widespread PIV login failures. Multiple users/sites reporting impact. Bridge opened, Identity & Access Management engaged. Service: Identity & PIV Authentication.

worklog.text: Update 1: Workaround: For now, we've added the intermediate CA manually to the trusted store on the Identity server. PIV authentication is working again.
Update 2: Monitoring: After deployment, we’re monitoring PIV login success rates. Current pass rate is 99.9% and no new failures observed.
Update 3: Monitoring: Post‑deployment checks show all PIV logins succeeding. We’re continuing to monitor logs for any lingering errors.
Update 4: Fix in progress: Renewed the intermediate CA and pushed the update to all auth nodes. Rollout scheduled for 20 minutes from now.
Update 5: Early triage: We’re seeing PIV login failures across all sites. Initial logs indicate authentication rejects with cert chain errors.
Update 6: Investigation: Analysis shows middleware trust store has an expired intermediate CA. This is affecting all PIV authentication requests.
Service restored. Cause: Expired intermediate CA certificate in middleware trust store. Root cause analysis tracked in PBI000000004105.
